settlement_source: Government of France plus ~16 named media (NYT, AP, Bloomberg, Reuters, Axios, Politico, Semafor, The Information, WaPo, WSJ, ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox, MSNBC, NBC); contract terms FRENCHPRES.pdf
settlement_variable: Identity of the first person elected President of France after Issuance (that candidate = Yes)
tie_handling: unknown (no tie clause in PDF; two-round runoff makes a tie practically moot)
trading_close_vs_settlement: close_time 2028-05-30T14:00Z is the latest expiry (one year after next election); if the payout event occurs, expiration moves earlier per Rule 7.2. Settlement no later than the day after expiration unless under Rule 7.1 review. Last trading = expiration.
early_close_or_void_clauses: can_close_early=1. Kalshi may start Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(d)) at sole discretion; if Expiration Value cannot be determined Kalshi sets payouts per Rule 6.3(b). No explicit clause for election cancellation/postponement, candidate withdrawal or death: unknown/discretionary.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says 'win the 2027 French presidential election' but rules say 'first person elected President after Issuance' - an earlier snap election (resignation/vacancy) would resolve it instead of 2027.
rules_primary says 'next French presidential election'; PDF says 'first elected after Issuance'. Same unless an early election occurs.
Succession/interim president does not count unless subsequently elected.
Latest expiry ~May 2028, more than a year after the expected April 2027 vote.
